\section{A short summary for bosonic and fermionic AFQMC:}

Let $g=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)=-\Omega$ for bosons and $g=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)$ for fermions. $h_{i}=\frac{1}{2}\chi^{T}gA_{i}\chi$, $\chi=\left(\begin{array}{c}
a_{1}\\
a_{2}\\
\vdots\\
a_{N}\\
a^{+}_{1}\\
a^{+}_{2}\\
\vdots\\
a^{+}_{N}
\end{array}\right)$ for bosons and $\chi=\left(\begin{array}{c}
c_{1}\\
c_{2}\\
\vdots\\
c_{N}\\
c^{+}_{1}\\
c^{+}_{2}\\
\vdots\\
c^{+}_{N}
\end{array}\right)$ for fermions. $gA+A^{T}g=0$($sp\left(2N,\mathbb{C}\right)$ for
bosons, $so\left(2N,\mathbb{C}\right)$ for fermions). 

We have the Lie algebra isomorphism described by $\left[\frac{1}{2}\chi^{T}gA_{1}\chi,\frac{1}{2}\chi^{T}gA_{2}\chi\right]=\frac{1}{2}\chi^{T}g\left[A_{1},A_{2}\right]\chi$.
We have
\[
p=\mathrm{tr}\left(e^{h_{1}}e^{h_{2}}\cdots e^{h_{k}}\right)=\det\left(I\mp e^{A_{1}}e^{A_{2}}\cdots e^{A_{k}}\right)^{\mp1/2}.
\]

For bosons, we have 6 passed cases:

1)Time reversal symmetry:(two $Z_{2}$ anti-linear symmetries) $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$,
$J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$, $J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$,
$\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

2)reflection positivity:$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$,
$J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$, $J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(non-contraction
semigroup)

Contraction semigroup cases:

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\bar{A},\\
J_{2}gA+A^{\dagger}J_{2}g & \leq0.
\end{align*}

3)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.Failed.

4)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.Failed.

$5)J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(non-hermitian
case I)

6)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(non-hermitian
case II)

7)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$. (Yinkai's case)

8)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$. (mainly non-hermitian)

9)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.Failed.

10)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.Failed.

11)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.Failed.

12)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.Failed.

13)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.Failed.

14)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.Failed.

15)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.Failed.

16)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.Failed.

List passed ones only:

1'')Time reversal symmetry:(two $Z_{2}$ anti-linear symmetries)
$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

2'')reflection positivity:$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$,
$J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$, $J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(non-contraction
semigroup)

3'')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(non-hermitian
case I)

4'')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(non-hermitian
case II)

5'')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$. (Yinkai's case)

6'')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$. (mainly non-hermitian)

For fermions, we have 7 examined cases:

1')(two $Z_{2}$ anti-linear symmetries)$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$,
$J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$, $J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.
It's just a special case of the semigroup case 9'.

2')The case corresponding to bosonic reflection positivity---exists
but not useful.

Contraction semigroup cases:
\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\bar{A},\\
iJ_{2}gA-iA^{\dagger}J_{2}g & \leq0,
\end{align*}

3')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(Majorana
reflection positivity)

4')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,

positivity)

5')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$. Passed

6')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$. Passed

7')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.Passed

$8')J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.Passed

9')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.Passed

10') $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$. Failed

List independent, passed ones only:

1''')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(Majorana
reflection positivity)

2''')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.(Time-reversal
positivity)

3''')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$. Passed

4''')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,

5''')$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,

\section{Tests for new bosonic cases}

Case 7:$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

Yinkai Yu's case $J_{1}=I_{2}\otimes\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N/2}$, $J_{2}=\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N}$.
Or easier: $J_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J_{2}=\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N}$.

metric is $\eta=J_{2}g$, contraction means ``physical''.

Case 8:$J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

$J_{1}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes\sigma_{z}\otimes I_{N/2}$, $J_{2}=\sigma_{x}\otimes\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N/2}$.

$J_{1}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

Assume $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)$, where $C_{11}=C^{T}_{11}$, $C_{22}=C^{T}_{22}$, $D_{11}=D^{T}_{11}$,
$D_{22}=D^{T}_{22}$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & -D_{22} & B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{21} & -D_{11} & D_{12}\\
B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22} & D^{T}_{12} & -D_{22}\\
-C_{11} & C_{12} & B_{11} & -B_{12}\\
C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22} & -B_{21} & B_{22}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}

So $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{11}$, $B_{22}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$, $B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{21}$,
$C_{11}=-\bar{D}_{11}$, $C_{22}=-\bar{D}_{22}$, $C_{12}=\bar{D}_{12}$.

So $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B^{\dagger}_{12} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B^{\dagger}_{12} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
C^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12}\\
B^{\dagger}_{12} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & C^{\dagger}_{12}\\
-\bar{B}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11}\\
C_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & B_{22} & B^{\dagger}_{12}\\
C_{12} & C_{11} & B_{12} & B_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}

For the generators of maximal subgroup, $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$,
$B_{12}=-B^{\dagger}_{12}$, $C_{11}=-C_{22}$, $C_{12}=C^{T}_{12}$.

$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B_{12} & B_{11} & C_{12} & -C_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{12}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$.

For the generators in the invariant cone, $B_{11}=B^{\dagger}_{22}$,
$B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{12}$, $C_{11}=C_{22}$, $C_{12}=-C^{T}_{12}$,

so $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{12} & -B_{11} & -C_{12} & C_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12}\\
-\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$,

\begin{align*}
J_{2}\Omega A & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{12} & -B_{11} & -C_{12} & C_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12}\\
-\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B_{12} & B_{11} & C_{12} & -C_{11}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
-\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12}
\end{array}\right)\leq0
\end{align*}

<=>$\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{12} & -B_{11} & -C_{12} & C_{11}\\
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{11} & B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{12}
\end{array}\right)\geq0$. Good.

Case 3: $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.

$J_{1}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N/2}$, $J_{2}=\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N}$
Also a Yin-Kai's case.

$J_{1}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
-D_{11} & -D_{12} & B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{21}\\
-B_{21} & -B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}\\
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{22} & B^{T}_{12} & -D_{22} & D^{T}_{12}\\
B^{T}_{21} & -B^{T}_{11} & D_{12} & -D_{11}\\
-C_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & B_{22} & -B_{21}\\
C_{12} & -C_{11} & -B_{12} & B_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}
We have $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$, $B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{12}$, $B_{21}=B^{\dagger}_{21}$,
$C_{11}=-\bar{D}_{22}$, $C_{22}=-\bar{D}_{11}$, $C_{12}=D^{\dagger}_{12}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & -B^{\dagger}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{22} & C^{\dagger}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & \bar{B}_{11}
\end{array}\right).$

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & -B^{\dagger}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{22} & C^{\dagger}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & \bar{B}_{11}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-\bar{C}_{22} & C^{\dagger}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & \bar{B}_{11}\\
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & -B^{\dagger}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21} & -\bar{C}_{22} & C^{\dagger}_{12}\\
-B^{T}_{12} & \bar{B}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11}\\
C_{11} & C_{12} & B_{11} & B_{12}\\
C^{T}_{12} & C_{22} & B_{21} & -B^{\dagger}_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}
For the generators of the maximal subgroup, $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{11}$,
$B_{12}=-B^{\dagger}_{21}$, $C_{11}=-C_{22}$, $C_{12}=C^{T}_{12}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B_{12} & B_{11} & C_{12} & -C_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{12}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right).$

For the generators in the convex cone, $B_{11}=B^{\dagger}_{11}$,
$B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{21}$, $C_{11}=C_{22}$, $C_{12}=-C^{T}_{12}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{12} & -B_{11} & -C_{12} & C_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$.
\[
J_{2}gA=\left(\sigma_{z}\otimes I_{N}\right)A\leq0
\]

Not a contraction semigroup.

Case 4: $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.

$J_{1}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N}$, $J_{2}=\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N}$
Also a Yin-Kai's case.

$J_{1}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N}=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N}=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

$A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
D & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)$, $C=C^{T}$, $D=D^{T}$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
-I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
D & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-B^{T} & -D\\
-C & B
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}
So $B=-B^{\dag}$, $C=-\bar{D}$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
-\bar{C} & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
-\bar{C} & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-B^{T} & -\bar{C}\\
C & B
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}

For the elements in the maximal subgroup, $C=0$.

For the elements in the convex cone, $B=0$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -\bar{C}\\
C & 0
\end{array}\right)$. 

$J_{2}g=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
I_{N} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N}
\end{array}\right)$, there's no contraction semigroup.

Case 9: $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

Also a Yin-Kai's case.

$J_{1}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\

I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & -D_{22} & B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{22}\\
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B_{21} & -B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{21} & D_{11} & -D_{12}\\
B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22} & -D^{T}_{12} & D_{22}\\
C_{11} & -C_{12} & B_{11} & -B_{12}\\
-C^{T}_{12} & C_{22} & -B_{21} & B_{22}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}

We have $B_{11}=-B^{\dag}_{11}$, $B_{22}=-B^{\dag}_{22}$, $B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{21}$,
$C_{11}=\bar{D}_{11}$, $C_{22}=\bar{D}_{22}$, $C_{12}=-\bar{D}_{12}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B^{\dag}_{12} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12}\\
-C^{\dag}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B^{\dag}_{12} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12}\\
-C^{\dag}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12}\\
-C^{\dag}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21} & \bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12}\\
B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{22} & -C^{\dag}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22}\\
C_{11} & C_{12} & B_{11} & B_{12}\\
-C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22} & B_{21} & B_{22}
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}

For the generators of the maximal subgroup, $B_{12}=0$, $C_{12}=0$.

For the generators in the convex cone, $B_{11}=B_{22}=0$, $C_{11}=C_{22}=0$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & B_{12} & 0 & C_{12}\\
B^{\dag}_{12} & 0 & C^{T}_{12} & 0\\
0 & -\bar{C}_{12} & 0 & -\bar{B}_{12}\\
-C^{\dag}_{12} & 0 & -B^{T}_{12} & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

There's no contraction semigroup.

0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

metrix is $-I_{N}$, no contraction semigroup.

Case 15: $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

$J_{1}=I_{N}$, $J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N}$.

$A$ is real.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
-I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
D & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-B^{T} & -D\\
-C & B
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}
For the convex cone $B=B^{\dagger}$, $C=\bar{D}$.

$J_{2}g=-I_{N}$, so there is no contraction semigroup.

Case 16: $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

$J_{1}=\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N}$, $J_{2}=I_{2}\otimes-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N/2}$.

$J_{1}=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0
\end{array}\right)$. 

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
D & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-B^{T} & D\\
C & B
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}
So $B=-B^{\dagger}$, $C=\bar{D}$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B^{\dagger}_{12} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & \bar{B}_{12}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{\dagger}_{12} & B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{22} & B^{\dagger}_{12} & C_{22} & -C^{T}_{12}\\
-B_{12} & B_{11} & -C_{12} & C_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{22} & -C^{\dagger}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22} & B^{T}_{12}\\
-\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}

For the convex cone, we have $B_{11}=-\bar{B}_{22}$, $B_{12}=-B^{T}_{12}$,
$C_{11}=\bar{C}_{22}$, $C_{12}=C^{\dagger}_{12}$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{B}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & \bar{C}_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & \bar{B}_{12}\\
C_{12} & C_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{\dag}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J_{2}gA & =\left(-i\sigma_{y}\otimes-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N/2}\right)A\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{B}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & \bar{C}_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & \bar{B}_{12}\\
C_{12} & C_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{\dag}_{11}
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
C_{12} & C_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{\dag}_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & -C^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{B}_{12}\\
B^{\dagger}_{12} & \bar{B}_{11} & -C^{T}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11}\\
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}
\end{array}\right)\leq0
\end{align*}

There's no contraction semigroup.

\section{Tests for new fermionic cases}

For fermions, $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)$, $C_{11}=-C^{T}_{11}$, $C_{22}=-C^{T}_{22}$, $D_{11}=-D^{T}_{11}$,
$D_{22}=-D^{T}_{22}$.

Case 1' $J_{1}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N/2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
-B_{21} & -B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21} & -D_{11} & -D_{12}\\
-B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22} & D^{T}_{12} & -D_{22}\\
-C_{11} & -C_{12} & B_{11} & B_{12}\\
C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22} & B_{21} & B_{22}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}

So $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{11}$, $B_{22}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$, $B_{12}=-B^{\dagger}_{21}$,
$C=-\bar{D}$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
C^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{21}\\
-B_{21} & -B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}\\
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{22} & B^{T}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & C^{\dagger}_{12}\\
B^{T}_{21} & -B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{11}\\
-C_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & B_{22} & -B_{21}\\
C_{12} & -C_{11} & -B_{12} & B_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}

So $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$, $B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{12}$, $C_{11}=C_{22}$,
$C_{12}=C^{T}_{12}$.

So $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B_{12} & B_{11} & -C_{12} & C_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{12}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$, $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{11}$, $B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{12}$, $C_{11}=-C^{T}_{11}$.
This is a non-hermitian case. I don't know how to prove it for this
case yet. I have tried the case with only $B_{11}\neq0$, it passed
the test. 

Case 5' $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.

$J_{1}=\sigma_{z}\otimes I_{N}=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
I_{N} & 0\\
0 & I_{N}
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N}=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
D & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)$, $C=-C^{T}$, $D=-D^{T}$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & -C\\
-D & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\bar{A}
\end{align*}

So $B=\bar{B}$, $C=-\bar{C}$, $D=-\bar{D}$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
-I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
D & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
D & -B^{T}\\
-B & -C
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-B^{T} & -D\\
-C & B
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}

So for the generators of the maximal subgroup $B=-B^{\dagger}$, $C=-\bar{D}$.

So $A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
C & B
\end{array}\right)$, $B=\bar{B}=-B^{T}=-B^{\dagger}$, $C=-C^{T}=-\bar{C}=C^{\dagger}.$
$B$ is non-hermitian, $C$ is hermitian.

For the generators in the convex cone, $B=B^{\dagger}$, $C=\bar{D}$.

So $A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
-C & -B
\end{array}\right)$, $B=\bar{B}=B^{T}=B^{\dagger}$, $C=-C^{T}=-\bar{C}=C^{\dagger}$.

$J_{2}gA=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-I_{N} & 0\\
0 & I_{N}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
-C & -B
\end{array}\right)=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-B & -C\\
-C & -B
\end{array}\right)\leq0$,

which is equivalent to $\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
C & B
\end{array}\right)\geq0$. So case 5' gives a semigroup! It might be a new kind of positivity.

Case 9': $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

$J_{1}=\sigma_{z}\otimes\sigma_{z}\otimes I_{N/2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N/2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}\\
-D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & -D_{22} & B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}
So $B_{11}=\bar{B}_{11}$, $B_{22}=\bar{B}_{22}$, $B_{12}=-\bar{B}_{12}$,
$B_{21}=-\bar{B}_{21}$, $C_{11}=-\bar{C}_{11}$, $C_{22}=-\bar{C}_{22}$,
$C_{12}=\bar{C}_{12}$, $D_{11}=-\bar{D}_{11}$, $D_{22}=-\bar{D}_{22}$,
$D_{12}=\bar{D}_{12}$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-B_{21} & -B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -D_{22} & D^{T}_{12}\\
-B^{T}_{21} & -B^{T}_{11} & -D_{12} & -D_{11}\\
-C_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & B_{22} & B_{21}\\
-C_{12} & -C_{11} & B_{12} & B_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}
So for the generators of the maximal subgroup, $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$,
$B_{12}=-B^{\dagger}_{12}$, $B_{21}=-B^{\dagger}_{21}$, $C_{11}=-\bar{D}_{22}$,
$C_{22}=-\bar{D}_{11}$, $C_{12}=D^{\dagger}_{12}$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & -B^{T}_{11} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-C_{12} & -C_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B_{11}
\end{array}\right)$. This is a hermitian case.

For the generators in the convex cone, $B_{11}=B^{\dagger}_{22}$,
$B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{12}$, $B_{21}=B^{\dagger}_{21}$, $C_{11}=\bar{D}_{22}$,
$C_{22}=\bar{D}_{11}$, $C_{12}=-D^{\dagger}_{12}$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B^{T}_{11} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
\bar{C}_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
C_{12} & C_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B_{11}
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
iJ_{2}gA & =-\sigma_{z}\otimes\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N/2}A\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B^{T}_{11} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
\bar{C}_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
C_{12} & C_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B_{11}
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B_{21} & -B^{T}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
C_{12} & C_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}
\end{array}\right)\leq0
\end{align*}

Case 10': $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

(1)$J_{1}=J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N}$.=> There is sign problem.

(2) $J_{1}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes\sigma_{z}\otimes I_{N/2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
-B_{21} & -B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21} & -D_{11} & -D_{12}\\
-B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22} & D^{T}_{12} & -D_{22}\\
-C_{11} & -C_{12} & B_{11} & B_{12}\\
C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22} & B_{21} & B_{22}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}
So $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{11}$, $B_{22}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$, $B_{12}=-B^{\dagger}_{21}$,
$C_{11}=-\bar{D}_{11}$, $C_{22}=-\bar{D}_{22}$, $C_{12}=-\bar{D}_{12}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right).$
\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-\bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-C^{\dagger}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{21} & \bar{C}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12}\\
B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22} & C^{\dagger}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22}\\
-C_{11} & C_{12} & B_{11} & -B_{12}\\
-C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22} & -B_{21} & B_{22}
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}

For the generators in the convex cone, $B_{11}=0$, $B_{22}=0$, $B_{12}=-B^{\dagger}_{21}$,
$C_{11}=0$, $C_{22}=0$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & B_{12} & 0 & C_{12}\\
B^{\dagger}_{12} & 0 & -C^{T}_{12} & 0\\
0 & -\bar{C}_{12} & 0 & -\bar{B}_{21}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & 0 & -B^{T}_{12} & 0
\end{array}\right).$

\begin{align*}
iJ_{2}gA & =-\sigma_{z}\otimes\sigma_{z}\otimes I_{N/2}A\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & B_{12} & 0 & C_{12}\\
B^{\dagger}_{12} & 0 & -C^{T}_{12} & 0\\
0 & -\bar{C}_{12} & 0 & -\bar{B}_{21}\\
C^{\dagger}_{12} & 0 & -B^{T}_{12} & 0
\end{array}\right)\leq0
\end{align*}

So there is sign problem for case ``wrong''.

Case 6' $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=-g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left\{ J_{1},J_{2}\right\} =0$.

$J_{1}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes\sigma_{z}\otimes I_{N/2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N/2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
D^{T}_{12} & -D_{22} & B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{21} & -D_{11} & D_{12}\\
B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22} & -D^{T}_{12} & -D_{22}\\
-C_{11} & C_{12} & B_{11} & -B_{12}\\
-C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22} & -B_{21} & B_{22}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}

So $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{11}$, $B_{22}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$, $B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{21}$,
$C_{11}=-\bar{D}_{11}$, $C_{22}=-\bar{D}_{22}$, $C_{12}=\bar{D}_{12}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-C^{\dag}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-C^{\dag}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-C^{\dag}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-B_{21} & -B_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & C^{\dag}_{12}\\
-B^{T}_{21} & -B^{T}_{11} & -\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{11}\\
-C_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & B_{22} & B_{21}\\
-C_{12} & -C_{11} & B_{12} & B_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}.
\end{align*}
For the generators of the maximal subgroup, $B_{11}=-B^{\dag}_{22}$,
$B_{12}=-B^{\dag}_{12}$, $C_{11}=C_{22}$, $C_{12}=C^{T}_{12}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
-B_{12} & B_{11} & -C_{12} & C_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{12}\\
-\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$.

For the generators in the convex cone, $B_{11}=B^{\dag}_{22}$, $B_{12}=B^{\dag}_{12}$,
$C_{11}=-C_{22}$, $C_{12}=-C^{T}_{12}$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{12} & -B_{11} & C_{12} & -C_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
iJ_{2}gA & =-\sigma_{z}\otimes\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N/2}A\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{12} & -B_{11} & C_{12} & -C_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11}
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B_{12} & B_{11} & -C_{12} & C_{11}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}\\
\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & B^{T}_{11}\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & \bar{C}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12}
\end{array}\right)\leq0
\end{align*}
Good, a new non-hermitian case. Possibly has positivity.

Case 7': $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

$J_{1}=I_{2N}$, $J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N}=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

$J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1}=\bar{A}$, $A$ is real.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & I_{N}\\
-I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
D & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
D & -B^{T}\\
-B & -C
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
0 & -I_{N}\\
I_{N} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-B^{T} & -D\\
-C & B
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}

For the generators of the maximal subgroup, $B=-B^{\dagger}$, $C=-\bar{D}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
-C & B
\end{array}\right)$.

For the generators in the convex cone, $B=B^{\dagger}$, $C=\bar{D}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
C & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)$.
\begin{align*}
iJ_{2}gA & =-\sigma_{z}\otimes I_{N}A\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cc}
-I_{N} & 0\\
0 & I_{N}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
C & -B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =-\left(\begin{array}{cc}
B & C\\
-C & B^{T}
\end{array}\right)\leq0
\end{align*}

With positivity.

Case 8': $J^{T}_{1}gJ_{1}=g$, $J^{2}_{1}=-I_{2N}$, $J^{T}_{2}gJ_{2}=-g$,
$J^{2}_{2}=-I_{2N}$, $\left[J_{1},J_{2}\right]=0$.

$J_{1}=\sigma_{x}\otimes-i\sigma_{y}\otimes I_{N/2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$, $J_{2}=-i\sigma_{y}\otimes\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N/2}=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{1}AJ_{1} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
D_{11} & D_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-D^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & -B^{T}_{22}\\
-D_{11} & -D_{12} & B^{T}_{11} & B^{T}_{21}\\
B_{21} & B_{22} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-B^{T}_{22} & B^{T}_{12} & D_{22} & D^{T}_{12}\\
B^{T}_{21} & -B^{T}_{11} & -D_{12} & D_{11}\\
C_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & B_{22} & -B_{21}\\
-C_{12} & C_{11} & -B_{12} & B_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\bar{A}
\end{align*}

We have $B_{11}=-B^{\dagger}_{22}$, $B_{12}=B^{\dagger}_{12}$, $B_{21}=B^{\dagger}_{21}$,
$C_{11}=\bar{D}_{22}$, $C_{22}=\bar{D}_{11}$, $C_{12}=D^{\dag}_{12}$.
So $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & -B^{\dagger}_{11} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & C^{\dagger}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & \bar{B}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$.

\begin{align*}
J^{T}_{2}AJ_{2} & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & -I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
-I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & B_{12} & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
B_{21} & -B^{\dagger}_{11} & -C^{T}_{12} & C_{22}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & C^{\dagger}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & \bar{B}_{11}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
-\bar{C}_{12} & \bar{C}_{22} & -B^{T}_{12} & \bar{B}_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & C^{\dagger}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & -B^{T}_{21}\\
-B_{21} & B^{\dagger}_{11} & C^{T}_{12} & -C_{22}\\
-B_{11} & -B_{12} & -C_{11} & -C_{12}
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0\\
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
\bar{B}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{22} & \bar{C}_{12}\\
-B^{T}_{21} & -B^{T}_{11} & -C^{\dagger}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11}\\
-C_{22} & C^{T}_{12} & -B^{\dagger}_{11} & B_{21}\\
-C_{12} & -C_{11} & B_{12} & B_{11}
\end{array}\right)=\pm\bar{A}
\end{align*}
For the generators of the maximal subgroup, $B_{12}=B_{21}=0$. $C_{11}=-C_{22}$.
$A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{11} & 0 & C_{11} & C_{12}\\
0 & -B^{\dagger}_{11} & -C^{T}_{12} & -C_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & C^{\dagger}_{12} & -B^{T}_{11} & 0\\
-\bar{C}_{12} & -\bar{C}_{11} & 0 & \bar{B}_{11}
\end{array}\right)$.

For the generators in the convex cone, $B_{11}=0$, $C_{11}=C_{22}$,
$C_{12}=0$. $A=\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & B_{12} & C_{11} & 0\\
B_{21} & 0 & 0 & C_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & 0 & 0 & -B^{T}_{21}\\
0 & \bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & 0
\end{array}\right)$.
\begin{align*}
iJ_{2}gA & =-\sigma_{z}\otimes\sigma_{x}\otimes I_{N/2}A\\
 & =-\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & I_{N/2} & 0 & 0\\
I_{N/2} & 0 & 0 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & -I_{N/2}\\
0 & 0 & -I_{N/2} & 0
\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
0 & B_{12} & C_{11} & 0\\
B_{21} & 0 & 0 & C_{11}\\
\bar{C}_{11} & 0 & 0 & -B^{T}_{21}\\
0 & \bar{C}_{11} & -B^{T}_{12} & 0
\end{array}\right)\\
 & =-\left(\begin{array}{cccc}
B_{21} & 0 & 0 & C_{11}\\
0 & B_{12} & C_{11} & 0\\
0 & -\bar{C}_{11} & B^{T}_{12} & 0\\
-\bar{C}_{11} & 0 & 0 & B^{T}_{21}
\end{array}\right)\leq0
\end{align*}
With positivity.

\section{Proofs}

.
